name: JUICE
first: Largest interplanetary spacecraft built in Europe; first spacecraft ever to orbit a moon of another planet (Ganymede, 2034)
description: JUpiter ICy moons Explorer — ESA's L-class flagship, launched 2023-04-14. The 8-year cruise uses one of the most complex gravity-assist sequences ever flown: a first-of-kind Lunar-Earth Gravity Assist on 2024-08-19, Venus 2025-08-31, then two more Earth passes in 2026 and 2029. Jupiter orbit insertion is set for 2031-07-21. After 35 close flybys of Europa, Ganymede, and Callisto over 3.5 years, JUICE will manoeuvre into a dedicated Ganymede orbit on 2034-12-31 — the first spacecraft ever to orbit a moon of another planet. Mission ends 2035 by impact on Ganymede. Primary science: existence + properties of subsurface oceans across the icy Galilean moons, ice-shell composition + tidal heating, and Jovian magnetospheric structure.

events.label: LAUNCH
events.note: Ariane 5 ECA lifts JUICE from Kourou.

events.label: LUNAR-EARTH FLYBY
events.note: First-ever Lunar-Earth Gravity Assist manoeuvre — Moon + Earth in one swing.

events.label: VENUS FLYBY
events.note: Venus gravity assist en route back to two more Earth passes.

events.label: JUPITER ORBIT INSERTION
events.note: Main engine burn places JUICE into Jupiter orbit for the icy-moons tour.
